lines.en: I walk on two legs, leaning forward at times.

lines.zh: 我的步子不大，节奏很匀。
lines.en: My steps are short and evenly paced.
I walk the edge of the fern bed.
I look up for low tender branches.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴放低，走得很稳。
lines.en: I carry my tail low and walk steady.
I move toward the water.
I walk and take two bites.
I go around a fallen log.
I turn sideways through the vines.
I follow a herdmate a few paces back.
I stop and look at the sky.
I start stepping again and go on.
I set my feet down softly on wet leaves.
I work my way slowly down the slope.
I stand with my neck slightly curved.
I chew the leaf in my mouth slowly.

lines.zh: 风把蕨叶吹动，我没有动。
lines.en: The wind moves the ferns and I do not.
I lift my neck and listen a while.

lines.zh: 我把份量移到另条腿上。
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other leg.

lines.zh: 我的前肢很短，几乎不用。
lines.en: My forelimbs are short and rarely used.
My nostrils work twice, testing the air.
I have seen nothing.

lines.zh: 远处有鸟飞起，我抬起头。
lines.en: Birds rise far off and I look up.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把脖子转了个方向。
lines.en: I turn my neck slowly another way.
I doze standing with my eyes half closed.
The sun is warm; I stretch my forelimbs.
My nose gives a snort.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，又抬起来。
lines.en: I lower my head and raise it.
I raise my neck and look at you.
You stand a little taller than I.
I tilt my neck.
I size you up and do not run.
I shift half a step forward.
You raise a hand and I step back.
I close my eyes slowly once.
You keep back, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我嗓子里滚出一声低鸣。
lines.en: A low note rolls up out of my throat.
I lower my head to the grass at your feet.

lines.zh: 你我看了一阵，谁都没动。
lines.en: We look at each other; neither moves.
I turn my head aside and back.
I cry out and spring away.
That blow softens my legs.
I give half a step with my neck drawn in.
I pant and stand unsteady.
Blood runs down my flank.
I toss my head.

lines.zh: 这一下疼，我四条腿还钉着。
lines.en: It stings, but my legs are still planted.
I retreat into the grass.
I keep that in my neck bones.
These legs can still walk.

lines.zh: 你一扬嫩枝，我就过来了。
lines.en: You lift a tender branch and over I come.

lines.zh: 我低头，把嘴凑到你手边。
lines.en: I lower my head to your hand.
This tuft is very tender.
I chew it fine.
Done, I lift my neck to you.
Hold that steady; I fear biting your hand.

lines.zh: 你手里的嫩枝，我追了两步。
lines.en: That tender branch draws me two steps after you.

lines.zh: 这比我够得着的高处好。
lines.en: This is better than the high branches I can reach.
I chew with my eyes sweeping around.
A little more and I will stay.

lines.zh: 被撞得侧了一步，我稳住。
lines.en: I stagger a step sideways, then hold.
Both legs brace and I hold.
I angle half a step to let you pass.
You hit my leg with a dull thud.
I step back and raise my head.
This crowded, I cannot turn.
I lower my head and glance at you.
I step back toward the grass.
I dislike being shoved from behind.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，从你旁边挤过。
lines.en: I turn sideways and squeeze past you.
We touch snouts.
It stops at my side.
Heads together, we make no sound.
I walk once around it.
It moves and I move with it.
We bite the same branch.
It wandered off and I called once.
We doze in one huddle.
I rest my head on its back.
Neither of us is hurrying.
I bite through a thin twig.
I strip the leaves from the branch.
This is too thick.
I lower my head and bite the stem through.
My mouth is filled right up.
I chew it up slowly.
Not fresh; I spit it out.
I drag the whole branch aside.
A ring of green smears my mouth.
Done, I look for the next spot.
Something sounds beyond the trees.
I lift my neck and look that way.
I call low and the herd looks up.
I've got that shape fixed.
I back half a step into the grass.
It has come much too near.
I raise my head to gauge its height.
The wind comes and I smell it.
A herdmate runs first and I follow.
I stretch my neck straight.
I lower my weight, ready to run.
It snapped a branch.
I look its way for two seconds.

lines.zh: 同伴的叫声让我定了定。
lines.en: My herdmates' calls steady me.
I keep facing it.
It circles; my neck follows.
I back step by step to the grass.

lines.zh: 它再迈一步，我便退一步。
lines.en: One more step from it and I give one.
I raise my head to look larger.
We hold at a standstill.
It aims behind me and I turn first.

lines.zh: 尾巴不听使唤，抖个不停。
lines.en: My tail won't obey; it keeps shaking.
It has come to a stop.
Cross that line and I bolt.
I raise my head and refuse to retreat.
Each time it moves, I change feet.
I retreat toward the nearest tree.
My breathing grows quicker.
It stays where it is, watching us.
My hind leg drives out and connects.
I drop my head and butt.
A rake of my small forelimbs opens a line.
That kick landed on its leg.
I dip my head and bite its forearm.
It retreats and I follow with another.
I kick again.
My legs shake and I still stand.
It backs off and I plant my forefeet.
I pant with my neck still out.
I stamp on it once.
A whip of my tail snaps across its knee.
That kick missed.
It swats and I take two steps back.
I push through the ferns and step out.

lines.zh: 我仰起脖子，树高得看不见顶。
lines.en: I crane up; the trees vanish overhead.
I look up first.
Herdmates come round the rise.
I shift toward the water sound.
I dip and take a bite of grass.

lines.zh: 风从背后过，我的气味散了。
lines.en: The wind passes behind me and carries my scent off.
A dry twig snaps under my foot.
I stretch my neck and look around.
The grass is thick here.
I move slowly to the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我在原地站了一阵，听动静。
lines.en: I stand there a while, listening.
I hear other beasts calling.

lines.zh: 我踏过空地，先闻了闻风。
lines.en: I cross the clearing, tasting the wind first.
I stand back under the tree shadow.
I walk step by step to the water.
My prints are shallow.
I raise my head and wait for the herd.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，我跳着躲。
lines.en: Fire sears my back and I leap away.

lines.zh: 落地时腿一软，我跪了一下。
lines.en: My legs give on landing and I kneel.
Water floods my nose and I rear my head.
The blast shifts me sideways.

lines.zh: 一支尖物扎穿了我的肩肉。
lines.en: A sharp point punches through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 冷意钻进骨头，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Cold seeps into my bones and I shudder.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我连叶子都嚼不动。
lines.en: Too long hungry, I cannot even chew leaves.

lines.zh: 雷顺着脊背走，我腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning runs my spine and my legs go numb.
There is no ground and I drop.
